title: Electromagnetic spectrum
design_rationale: Establish common transverse behaviour and speed before learning approximate regions.
concepts_taught: State that every electromagnetic wave is transverse.
Use the common free-space speed c with v = fλ.
Order the principal electromagnetic regions by wavelength and frequency.
Recall approximate wavelength boundaries and the 400–700 nm visible range.

next_module_can_assume: State that every electromagnetic wave is transverse.
Use the common free-space speed c with v = fλ.
Order the principal electromagnetic regions by wavelength and frequency.
Recall approximate wavelength boundaries and the 400–700 nm visible range.
next_module_must_not_assume: Relate plane polarisation to restriction of transverse oscillations.
